title: Identify the remaining C: disk queue/write-latency pressure during the post-restart gate window
outcome: Identify the workload or writers behind the observed loaded C: disk queue/write-latency pressure, or name the missing attribution evidence and a bounded next discriminator. Preserve the distinction from the central host's aggregate write rate and the historical Windows hard reset.
acceptance: The 2026-10-26 01:47:05Z–01:58:27Z OS capture and concurrent-load timeline are recorded, including raw artifacts, stable host identity, counter coverage and cadence gaps.

A bounded, coordinator-authorized discriminator identifies the dominant workload/writers or explicitly records why attribution remains unavailable; no live-store access or historical hang-causation claim is used.
Any proposed mitigation is tied to the observed cause and independently reviewed; if no mitigation is justified, record the evidence and an explicit disposition.
